name: Li Tieguai
material: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk
dimensions: Image: 100.5 x 38.4 cm (39 9/16 x 15 1/8 in.); Overall with knobs: 182 x 59.2 cm (71 5/8 x 23 5/16 in.)
summary: It is said that Li Tieguai’s ethereal self visited the deified Laozi but when he returned, he found that his own body was burned.
